'<25%' = STRICTLY LESS THAN 25.00%; exactly 25.0% DOES NOT fire. Rounding is taken AS FILED - I do not re-derive a figure to more precision than the issuer stated it (that is the ASSUMPTION class this file already bars).

# P9. (a) RESET / RUN RULE, and what an UNMEASURED quarter does (DAEDALUS's surviving ASK (i) - ADS and CCLFX exercise it). The run is PER VEHICLE and counts CONSECUTIVE quarters. IT RESETS TO 0 ON ANY OF: (1) a quarter satisfied IN FULL (>=100.0%); (2) a quarter whose satisfaction is UNMEASURABLE or INFERRED-ONLY rather than issuer-stated; (3) a quarter in which the vehicle MADE NO REPURCHASE OFFER AT ALL. => AN UNMEASURED QUARTER BREAKS THE RUN. IT DOES NOT PAUSE IT. Reason: a PAUSE would assert a run ACROSS a quarter I cannot observe - inferring the unobserved in the direction of my book, which is the same defect this file already rules against for ADS ('inference does not count'). !! CASE (3) IS NOT A BENIGN READ AND MUST NOT BE FILED AS ONE: a vehicle SUSPENDING its repurchase programme is a MORE severe fact than a sub-100% quarter, and this gate is not built to grade it - record it as NO-OFFER, break the run, and route it SEPARATELY to WALTER as a red signal. Laundering a suspension into a run count is the failure mode.
